label.zh:
所有能前往[Root.Capital.System.GetName]星系的成员国均会被邀请参与联合行动。

如果他们接受，他们必须投入资源建造纪念碑，这会增加联邦经验和[Root.GetName]的影响力。

[Root.GetName]还可以选择在两个成员国中提升[Root.GetHegemonyEthos]的吸引力。

如果这一提议遭到广泛拒绝，联邦团结度将会下降，[Root.GetName]会损失影响力。
label.en:
All member states with access to the [Root.Capital.System.GetName] system will be approached to take part in the joint operation.

If they accept, they will have to dedicate resources to a monument which will boost Federation Experience and the [Root.GetName]'s Influence.

The [Root.GetName] will also be able to choose to increase [Root.GetHegemonyEthos] attraction in two member states.

If the proposal is widely rejected, Federation Cohesion will decrease and the [Root.GetName] will lose Influence.

label.zh: 对方对我方的态度修正「同意团结盛典」
label.en: Opinion modifier "Agreed to Celebration of Unity"
